The person who had the service with the IP address, answered the door and wasn't of interest, but - to the officer's credit - they realised that they were in a block of flats and decided to door knock the neighbours. Cue a couple of punks answering their front door with a stack of stolen laptops sitting on the coffee table behind them. Customer got her stolen laptop back and punks got arrested.
